mapper.sql: ( #{h.baseText} + CASE WHEN p.images IS NOT NULL AND p.images <> '' THEN #{h.baseImage} ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN p.title IS NOT NULL AND p.title <> '' THEN #{h.baseTitle} ELSE 0 END + #{h.weightLike} * p.like_count + #{h.weightComment} * p.comment_count + #{h.weightRepost} * p.repost_count + #{h.weightView} * p.view_count + CASE WHEN p.create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{h.newPostHours} HOUR) THEN #{h.newPostBoost} ELSE 0 END - LEAST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, p.create_time, NOW()) * #{h.decayPerHour}, #{h.decayMax}) )
